# SemanticGroup

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Groups child elements under an explicit accessibility role without adding visual styling.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `VerticalStack`. Implements `IRoleProvider`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new SemanticGroup(role: SemanticRole, options?: SemanticGroupOptions)
new SemanticGroup(options: SemanticGroupOptions & { role: SemanticRole; })
```

## Properties

- [`semanticRole`](#semanticrole): The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. `SemanticRole.H1`, `SemanticRole.P`, `SemanticRole.Figure`).
